## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `swift build`
- [ ] `swift run moonglade-tests`
- [ ] `./scripts/build-app.sh`

## Review

- [ ] An adversarial review and a score, written by someone other than the author, are recorded here or linked ([how](https://github.com/ixjosemi/Moonglade/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#review-before-merge)).
- [ ] Every critical and major finding is fixed or answered with a reason.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, personal session data, or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Changes to input handling, filesystem access, process execution, permissions, or integrations have tests.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated.
